headline: Klingbeil holds the Zuckersteuer line after the Chancellery stop; Union threatens to block his income-tax bill until Bas delivers pension/labor drafts; Google’s Project Suncatcher TPUs reach orbit; Boston Dynamics ships a 13-DOF Atlas hand.

stories.title: Zuckersteuer: Chancellery brakes; Klingbeil still says it will come
facts: Kanzleramt paused Klingbeil’s soft-drink sugar-levy draft — government circles (dpa/tagesschau): diverges from Finanzkommission Gesundheit; “nicht mehrheitsfähig.”
Draft: levy from 1 Jul 2027 on drinks ≥5 g sugar/100 ml; Zero/ersatz, pure juices, AF beer/wine exempt. MoF ~€1 bn/yr vs commission ~€450 m (two tiers, max 32¢/L vs Klingbeil peak 38¢).
Today (SPIEGEL ~11:12): Klingbeil to ZDFheute/RTL/n-tv — “Wir haben verabredet, eine Zuckersteuer einzuführen. Wir werden das auch tun”; expects a quick deal; frames child health.
SPD deputy Schweitzer (dpa): surprised by the open Chancellery brake — “nicht zuträglich” for coalition trust; NGG plans 8 Oct MoF protest.
stories.whyItMatters: Fresh Friday midday pushback from Klingbeil turns Thursday’s Chancellery stop into an open coalition-finance fight — and the levy is tied into GKV/health-fund funding before the budget vote.

stories.title: Union presses Bas on pensions — threatens to block Klingbeil tax bill
facts: CDU GS Hoppermann (FAZ): Labor Minister Bas must table the pension draft so talks can get concrete; Merz wants labor flexibilization on the 7 Oct Koalitionsausschuss.
Union Fraktion (Handelsblatt/dpa via WELT & n-tv): discussed blocking Klingbeil’s income-tax bill until Bas delivers pension + labor drafts — July package framed as linked.
Flashpoints: end of penalty-free early retirement after 45 years (also opposed by three eastern CDU MPs); Bild cites 4-yr sachgrundlose Befristung + looser Kündigungsschutz above €177k.
WELT/SPIEGEL: Steinmeier phoned Klingbeil and Dobrindt amid a care-reform flare-up; a government official called the mood “echte Ampel-Vibes.”
stories.whyItMatters: Same Friday coalition stress as the Zuckersteuer fight — tax relief for SPD vs. pensions/labor for the Union, with the committee and first tax reading stacked Oct 7–8.

stories.title: Google Project Suncatcher prototype reaches orbit
facts: Google Research (Travis Beals, Oct 1): Project Suncatcher prototype satellite — built with Planet — launched on SpaceX Transporter-18; contact confirmed, “operating as expected.”

Mission: gather in-orbit data on how Google TPUs handle launch stress, radiation and thermal extremes — first step of a moonshot on whether space can host scalable ML infrastructure (peer-reviewed paper in Joule).
NPR context: fridge-sized craft carries four TPUs; plans to run Gemma briefly (~15 min bursts for heat); 2027 follow-on aims to test high-bandwidth laser links between two more sats.
stories.whyItMatters: Primary vendor hardware-in-space milestone overnight into the Friday window — not Crew-13, and not yet an orbital data center.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics: new 13-DOF Atlas hand (no pinky)
facts: Boston Dynamics blog (picked up by heise ~12:17): next-gen Atlas hand jumps from 7 to 13 DOF — four fingers, denser fingertip/palm pressure sensing, encapsulated backdrivable direct actuators.

Designed for pinch/tripod grasps, in-hand reorientation, and triggered tool use (drills, drivers, welders); sized like a large human hand; claims ~100 lb+ loaded-minifridge class strength with the body.
No pinky after an internal “tape your pinky for a day” experiment — three fewer actuators for cost/repair/mass-manufacture; built for high-fidelity sim2real RL.
stories.whyItMatters: Concrete humanoid hardware step aimed at factory tool use, not another demo reel — primary vendor post landing in DE tech feeds today.

stories.title: Berlin: Vorgespräche resume Saturday morning
facts: Update vs last evening’s “maybe weekend”: taz (Fri ~10:56) — Tagesspiegel says Linke/Greens/SPD Vorgespräch continues Saturday morning; no denial to taz.
Still not Sondierungen: Greens/SPD want a firmer Linke antisemitism line (Graf: unspecified “Mechanismus”); Thu ~5h at Haus der Statistik ended with only “konstruktiv.”
Parties used Friday for internal Rückkopplung after leaving Thu without naming a next date.
stories.whyItMatters: Material scheduling update on the capital’s coalition gate — antisemitism/OK still block formal Sondierungen.
